name: short-value-copy
what: time of copied_string for one value under 16 bytes, in a loop over a list of values that moves the output position by the count, as a render does; ns per value
purpose_in_the_task_list: A masked AVX-512 form of the escape was measured on 2026-10-12 (stocks page, g++ 16 -O2, x86-64-v4: 990 to 1000 ns against 1254 ns for the form without it) and was not merged; its result files and its source are lost, and no file says why it was not merged. The owner asked for a new measurement, with the probe, the result and the reason kept. This run measures the copy of a short value only; the decision is the owner's
method: not the method of mbedded-cbor/bench/README.md: 6 rounds, the arm order alternates by round (forward, then reversed), each process 5 repetitions of 2^22 values for each input, timed with std::chrono::steady_clock; arm 1 is arm 0 built twice; each arm is held to the scalar form (every length 0 to 40 with no mark and with each mark at each position, the same with marks written behind the size through resize_and_overwrite, and every value of the inputs) before it is timed; no gate, no steal; arms 10 and 11 are also held to the scalar form for each such value as a std::string_view that ends at the last byte of a std::array<char, 40>, with an array of 16 marks behind it in the same struct (a read past the length that reaches the result shows as a mark or as a byte that is not zero behind the count)

arms.0: the form of dbd4cac: a value of up to 16 bytes in a string whose capacity() + 1 >= 16 is read as one 16-byte block (_mm_loadu_si128), the marks masked to the length
arms.1: the same code as arm 0, a second binary: the noise of the cell
arms.8: arm 6 with the test of a value under 16 bytes first, the empty value returns before the read
arms.10: a value of 1 to 16 bytes: one masked load _mm_maskz_loadu_epi8 with the low n bits as mask (it reads only the n bytes of the value and gives zero for the other bytes), marks from the five compares without a mask (a zero byte is no mark), one 16-byte store at the start of the room as in arm 8; the empty value and values of 17 to 32 bytes as in arm 8; needs AVX-512BW and AVX-512VL
arms.11: arm 10 with a masked store _mm_mask_storeu_epi8 of the n bytes of the value: nothing is stored past the length

inputs.render: the values under 16 bytes of bench/render.cpp in render order: workload 2 (rowClass, index, symbol twice, name, price, negativeClass, change, negativeClass, ratio of 20 stocks) then workload 3 (the title twice, then author, date and three tag names of 20 articles); workload 1 has none; marked values: class="minus" and Today's news
inputs.render-plain: the same list with each mark replaced by x
inputs.fixed-N: 64 values of N bytes of x; fixed-N-marked: the last byte is <

strings_of_arm_0: every value is a std::string made from a short string_view, so it lies in the buffer inside the string (libstdc++: capacity() 15, a buffer of 16 chars); main checks capacity() + 1 >= 16 for every value before the run and stops if one fails; arm 0 tests the same in reads_past_size_safely
builds: g++-16 and clang++-23, -O2 and -Os, -march=x86-64-v4 only (arms 10 and 11 need AVX-512BW and AVX-512VL; with -march=x86-64-v3 they stop at an #error, so no x86-64-v3 build is made in this run); -std=c++26 -DNDEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Werror -falign-functions=64 -falign-loops=64 (g++ also -falign-jumps=64) -DARM=<arm>; one binary for each arm and build
headers: none (probe.cpp holds a copy of the parts of include/mustache/escape.hpp that it needs)
